text: Target-decoy database searching in proteomics estimates the false discovery rate by matching spectra against a database of known contaminant proteins such as keratin.
explanation: False. Target-decoy searching estimates FDR by searching against a reversed or randomized version of the target protein database, using decoy hits as an estimate of the false match rate, not against a contaminant database. Filtering out contaminants like keratin is a separate quality-control step, distinct from FDR estimation, and is more analogous to CRAPome-style filtering used in interaction proteomics.
